preconditions.description: The number of vertices n must be between 2 and 100,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= v <= n and 1 <= u <= n for v, u in edges)
preconditions.description: All edge endpoints v and u must be valid vertex indices between 1 and n.
The number of edges must be exactly n - 1, as it is a tree.

postconditions.description: The output must contain exactly n numbers, one for each k from 1 to n.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= int(x) <= n for x in stdout.split())
postconditions.description: Each output number must be a non-negative integer not exceeding n.
The output must be the maximum number of paths for each k, formatted as space-separated integers.
